notes: Opening a chat now lands on the newest message: it keeps pinning to the bottom until everything has loaded, instead of giving up after a moment and leaving you on an older message. Opening the keyboard no longer hides half the conversation — the chat rises with the keyboard and settles back when it closes. While the chat is still connecting or fetching messages, the header says Connecting… in amber, so a quiet chat is never mistaken for one where nobody wrote. Videos: a video that can't play no longer shows an empty black box — it now says Couldn't play, with the reason, and a tap retries; videos also load noticeably faster. If a video sent from a computer has no sound, the video now tells you whether the file has no sound track at all. If you still see a video problem, the message under the video says exactly what went wrong — send it over.
